“Original is a medium firm mattress featuring Sleepyhead’s BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam technology.”

“It uses a three-layer system: a soft foam top layer for comfort, a BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam layer that adapts to your body and relieves pressure, and a high-resilient foam base for strong support and durability.”
“It contours to your body shape, weight, and sleep position to provide personalized support throughout the night.”
